ITAScanner Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 4, 2026

ITAScanner processes documents on your iPhone. The app does not send document content or personal data to an app server. It has no account system, advertising, analytics SDK, tracking, or automatic cloud synchronization.

Documents and photos

Camera images, selected photos, recognized text, PDF files, and handwritten signatures are processed on the device. Text recognition and portrait background processing use Apple frameworks on the device. ITAScanner does not use a remote AI service.

Camera permission allows document scanning. Photos permission allows the app to read the photos you select. You can grant limited Photos access and change these permissions in iPhone Settings. The app requests local photo images with network access disabled. If the selected original is unavailable on the device, the app reports an import failure.

The app does not automatically save scans back to your Photos library. Your original photos stay in Photos. Existing Photos synchronization settings are controlled by iOS, not ITAScanner.

Storage and removal

Saved PDFs stay in the app's private document storage. ITAScanner applies iOS file protection and excludes its document storage and trash from iCloud and device backups. Export important files yourself before deleting the app or changing devices.

Moving a document to the app's trash keeps a recoverable local copy. It does not permanently erase the document. The app currently restores the contents of its trash together. Deleting the app removes its local documents and trash. Copies that you exported to another location remain at that location.

You can add an opening password when saving a scan PDF. Password protection uses Apple's PDF frameworks. The app has no password recovery service. Keep your password separately. File protection and a PDF password do not control what a recipient does with an exported copy.

Actions that you choose

Sharing gives the PDF to the app or storage destination you select. Printing gives it to the system print service and selected printer. A file provider selected during import can retrieve files through its own service. Those destinations and providers follow their own privacy policies and network behavior.

ITAScanner's explicit text-copy buttons use the local clipboard and disable Universal Clipboard transfer for that copy. The app does not control text handling after you paste it into another app. System selection menus and other apps follow their own settings.

Apple services and feedback

Apple manages app distribution, permissions, and operating-system services. TestFlight can provide crash information and feedback to the developer through Apple's systems. If you submit feedback or contact support, the developer receives the information that you choose to send. Do not include private document content in feedback unless it is necessary for the issue. This policy does not describe Apple's separate data practices.

Contact

For support and privacy requests, use the public contact.
